title: Where the Pacific Crest Trail meets the highway
text: Walker Pass Campground sits just off Highway 178, at the junction of the Owens Peak and Cache Peak segments of the Pacific Crest National Scenic Trail. It has eleven walk-in sites for Pacific Crest Trail hikers and tent campers, plus two sites for car camping. Pinyon pines and a few Joshua trees grow there, but no drinking water is available at the site.
